clock_model.rtl_boundary: phase_clk_i runs at four times E; enabled rising edges advance address, AS-close, E-rise data, and E-fall data subphases in order
clock_model.historical_boundary: the on-chip oscillator derives E and sequences AS, address, Port 3 data direction, R/W, and IOS around each E cycle
clock_model.limitation: The digital subphase ordering is implemented; manufacturer nanosecond minima/maxima, pad delay, oscillator behavior, and electrical pull strength remain outside synthesizable RTL

signals.name: phase_clk_i
signals.fact: four enabled rising edges represent one E cycle and no internally generated clock is used

signals.name: phase_reset_n_i
signals.fact: asynchronously initializes the subphase counter; this is intentionally distinct from historical RESET

signals.name: clock_enable_i
signals.fact: low holds both the subphase counter and normalized MCU state

signals.name: reset_n_i
signals.fact: active low resets the device while E continues; controlled bus outputs assume documented reset digital levels

signals.name: e_o
signals.fact: low in address and AS-close subphases and high in the two data subphases

signals.name: bus_phase_o
signals.fact: 0 address, 1 AS-close/turnaround, 2 E-rise data, and 3 E-fall data

signals.name: sc1_i
signals.historical: IS3 input in single-chip Modes 4 and 7
signals.fact: sampled as the Port 3 input-strobe source only when SC1 is not an output

signals.name: sc1_o
signals.historical: AS in multiplexed modes or IOS in Mode 5
signals.fact: AS is high only in the address subphase; IOS is low exactly for addresses 0100 through 01FF

signals.name: sc1_oe_o
signals.fact: enabled in expanded Modes 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, and 6; disabled in single-chip Modes 4 and 7

signals.name: sc2_o
signals.historical: R/W in expanded modes or OS3 in single-chip modes
signals.fact: R/W is high for reads and low for writes; the pin carries the documented Port 3 output strobe in single-chip modes

signals.name: port3_i
signals.fact: read data is sampled by the normalized MCU before the E-fall advancement boundary

signals.name: port3_o
signals.fact: low address in multiplexed address phase, write/internal-monitor data during E, or GPIO in single-chip modes

signals.name: port3_oe_o
signals.fact: multiplexed low address is driven before AS closes; the bus is released for turnaround and read data; writes drive only while E is high

signals.name: port4_i
signals.fact: used as GPIO in single-chip configurations

signals.name: port4_o
signals.fact: high address in multiplexed modes, low address in Mode 5, or GPIO in single-chip modes

signals.name: port4_oe_o
signals.fact: always-address or DDR-controlled behavior follows the selected operating mode

signals.name: operating_mode_o
signals.fact: reports the active mode so the documented irreversible Mode 4 to Mode 5 transition is observable

halt_interrupt_behavior: MC6801 has no HALT pin; WAI, interrupt recognition, and vector cycles advance only at the E-fall normalized-cycle boundary while the four-subphase pin sequencer remains deterministic
